# Vendored dependency

`wechatauto-replica` is included as a source snapshot for the application and release build. Its upstream project is <https://github.com/fanyuantaier/wechatauto-replica>. The dependency's license is preserved in `wechatauto-replica/LICENSE`; it applies to that dependency only.

The snapshot contains project-specific compatibility changes. Review the source and upstream terms before updating or redistributing it. No nested Git history is required to build this project.
